notes: Timing is descriptive for this shared cloud environment, not a production latency guarantee. No local compilation or deliberate load generation overlapped these final runs; other tenants and scheduler effects remain uncontrolled.

All raw rows from all repeats are pooled. P95/P99 use nearest rank; no outlier removal. CPU/basic have 300 samples each implementation; other main hot/cold paths have 3000. Scaling has300 per implementation per case.
CPU/basic sleep 210ms before each timed call, excluding sleep from durations. cpu_hot/basic_hot have different CPU freshness policies and are intentionally not comparable.

Process parity gates compare full PID inventories and an idle controlled child common fields; each raw process sample records actual process count. Both compared RSS paths use statm semantics, which remains a kernel approximation.
Process counts include the benchmark process and runner/shell, not only controlled sleep children. Every final scaling sample had exactly 100/500/1000/5000 records.
Network results from network-fixed supersede the older network rows in hot after the 89e6c6c interface-generation fix. Non-network native code remained unchanged from b469697.

In this restricted network namespace, sysinfo returns an empty interface list; full network and all-module full comparisons are unavailable. zsys-only counter or complete network times are not sysinfo speedups.

Rust allocation counts/bytes include successful alloc, alloc_zeroed, realloc requests. Retained heap excludes the measurement sample vector; C-library allocations, allocator metadata, stack and mappings are not counted. VmHWM includes those plus harness/loader and is the OS-reported peak, not exact collector-only memory.

The earlier requested 10000-process run hit an available-memory safety threshold at 6340 actual visible processes. Its timing used the superseded stat-RSS path and is not a final same-scope result. The resource limit itself is recorded in the development archive.
Cold means constructing, first-refreshing and dropping collectors with warm OS caches, not reboot-cold storage or a fresh executable for every sample.
